Glendale visit planning

An Organic Spa Pedicure visit
from Glendale to Element 16.

Plan the service and live route from your actual starting point. Element Nail Bar does not have a Glendale storefront; this appointment takes place at Element Nail Bar — 16th Street, 6022 N 16th St in Phoenix.

Reserve nowDirectionsCallMenu

From Glendale

Choose the pedicure first, then plan the trip.

Glendale covers a wide area, so the practical route can change by neighborhood. Select the complete service before checking live directions, then compare the round trip with another Element location if that better fits the day.

See all area guides →

Route and arrival

Check live directions after you know the appointment length.

Grand Avenue, Loop 101, I-10, or I-17 may be useful depending on the exact Glendale starting point. Recheck traffic close to departure, especially during commute hours or major events, and allow time for the salon's free on-site parking.

Open Google Maps →

Choose the location that fits the day

Compare 99th Avenue when it better fits your starting point.

Review the address, services, and current availability at Element Nail Bar — 99th Avenue before deciding. If Organic Spa or a preferred artist leads you to Element 16, complete that reservation before opening directions.

Visit Element Nail Bar — 99th Avenue →

Organic Spa Pedicure

Choose Organic Spa before planning the Glendale trip.

Start with Organic Spa Pedicure when that featured experience fits the visit. The booking page shows the current price, total time, and massage time. Regular polish is included; select gel removal, French, or other available add-ons separately when they apply.

Review Organic Spa →

Before leaving Glendale

Confirm availability and the complete appointment.

Walk-ins are welcome when an artist is available, but appointments are recommended for specialty services, weekends, and multiple guests. The salon is open Monday–Saturday 9:30 AM–7 PM and Sunday 10 AM–5 PM; booking availability may end earlier. Call 602-607-5686 if you need help matching the reservation to the requested work.

View current menu →

Compare pedicures

Use the current timing and add-ons to choose the right pedicure.

Compare all current pedicure options by total time, massage time, and the finish or add-ons needed. Reserve removal when gel is already on the toes so the appointment reflects the work.

Compare spa pedicures →

Multiple guests

Prepare each guest's service before calling.

For two or three guests, have each name and requested service ready before calling. Different service lengths affect whether appointments can begin together; groups larger than three should call the salon.

Compare group services →

Live directions

Open the route shortly before departure.

Confirm that navigation is leading to Element Nail Bar — 16th Street and use current traffic conditions for the final route.
